details: US consumer prices (CPI) rose 3.8% year-over-year in April, up from 3.3% previously, driven partly by a 0.6% month-over-month increase and a 28% year-over-year surge in gasoline prices. Wholesale inflation (Producer Price Index, PPI) also climbed significantly, rising 6.0% year-over-year in April and 1.0% month-over-month for core PPI, both exceeding consensus estimates. This hotter-than-expected inflation data has led to increased concerns about prolonged tight monetary policy.
title: US Inflation Surges, Fuelling Rate Hike Fears

details: Following the latest inflation reports, the 10-year Treasury yield surged to 4.55%, reaching its highest level in a year. This reflects growing market concerns that persistent inflation, partly due to the ongoing Middle East conflict and elevated energy prices, could prompt the Federal Reserve to consider rate hikes. Futures trading now shows a 45% chance of a Fed rate hike in 2026, a significant increase from 1% just a month ago.
title: Treasury Yields Hit One-Year Highs Amid Inflationary Pressure

details: The cryptocurrency market saw a significant downturn, with its total market cap falling by 3.37% and over $90 billion in value lost in recent hours. Bitcoin dropped to approximately $77,678, while major altcoins also saw sharp losses. This sell-off is largely attributed to macroeconomic pressures, specifically the disappointing PPI inflation data, which reduced hopes for Federal Reserve rate cuts and led investors to offload risky assets. US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded another $290 million in outflows, contributing to a total of $1.15 billion in outflows over the past week, ending a six-week inflow streak. Bitcoin miners also added to selling pressure by offloading around 800 BTC.
title: Crypto Market Experiences Sharp Sell-Off Amid Macro Pressures and ETF Outflows

details: The CLARITY Act passed the Senate Banking Committee with bipartisan support. Additionally, the Senate Banking Committee advanced a broader crypto market structure bill on a 15-9 vote, with bipartisan support, indicating progress towards comprehensive digital asset regulation in the United States. While some senators expressed outstanding concerns, the advancement suggests a significant step towards greater regulatory clarity for the cryptocurrency sector.
title: US Senate Committee Advances Key Crypto Regulatory Bills

details: Kevin Warsh has been confirmed by the Senate as the new Federal Reserve Chair, succeeding Jerome Powell. Warsh takes the helm at a challenging time, with rising inflation concerns and growing market expectations for potential rate hikes.
title: Kevin Warsh Confirmed as New Federal Reserve Chair

details: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) released its May 2026 Monetary Policy Statement, indicating expectations for underlying inflation to remain high throughout the rest of 2026. This is attributed to persistent capacity pressures in the labor market and increased fuel costs from the Middle East conflict. The RBA anticipates headline inflation to peak at 5.2% in June 2026, and its forecasts assume the cash rate will increase to 4.70% by the end of 2026.
title: Reserve Bank of Australia Signals Sustained High Inflation and Rate Hikes
